verify.title: Verify your identity
verify.subtitle: QURBI checks every courier before they can take jobs. Upload clear photos of these four documents.
verify.photoTip: Make sure all four corners are visible and the text is sharp and readable.

icFront.label: Front of IC
icFront.hint: The side with your photo and IC number.

selfie.label: Selfie
selfie.hint: Take a clear photo of your face, no mask or sunglasses.

licence.label: Driving licence
licence.hint: The valid licence for the vehicle you registered.

verify.uploadFailed: That upload failed. Please try again.
verify.missing: Upload all four documents to continue.
verify.failed: Could not submit your documents. Please try again.

pending.title: We are reviewing your documents
pending.body: This usually takes up to one working day. We will notify you the moment you are approved.
pending.step1: QURBI checks your IC, selfie and driving licence.
pending.step2: You get a notification with the result.
pending.step3: Once approved you can go online and accept jobs.

rejected.title: We could not approve your documents
rejected.body: Please fix the problem below and submit your documents again.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.body: You cannot go online or accept jobs right now. Jobs already assigned to you stay with you until QURBI reassigns them.
suspended.contact: If you think this is a mistake, please contact QURBI support.
